summary: Union rear admiral, Farragut's second-in-command at New Orleans 1862; John's 4th cousin 7x removed via Bull Smith.
bio: Path: Bull Smith → Richard 2d → Richard 3rd (b. 1696) → Phebe Smith, m. (Capt.) Nathaniel Platt in 1776 → Phebe Platt, m. Judge William Bailey of Plattsburgh → Theodorus. Would have become 3C7R had Temperance been Ebenezer's daughter (ruled out). Same pages show Richard 3rd's daughter Sarah married Rev. Naphtali Daggett, later president of Yale (p. 471; in-law). F. K. Smith pp. 119–122 also list Charity Smith m. John Adams, Gloriana m. Joseph Bryant, Isaac Smith b. 30 Oct 1745 m. Margaret Field/Theal, and 'Shell Dick'.

military.note: Second-in-command to Farragut at the capture of New Orleans, 1862.

sources: F. K. Smith (1967) pp. 119–122 (screenshots in John's Drive)
